richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Serampore

c: Serampore is an old riverside town on the Hooghly, with a historic college, jute mill neighbourhoods and narrow lanes that leave little open space. The open land that does exist, along the river front, in school compounds and in municipal parks, is precious. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to Serampore that makes good use of small areas, made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away.

We deliver to West Bengal by road and install through our team or a dealer in the east. Every machine stands on its own foundation, so a long, thin strip by the river can take a single row of stations. Before we manufacture anything, we send a layout drawing showing the machines, the walking space and the clear zones, so you can see the plan in full. Residents and committee members can mark changes on it before you approve.

Riverside air is damp for much of the year. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts suit these conditions, since they resist rust. Keep the base slightly raised and away from the bank, because heavy monsoon rain can bring water up quickly.

items.q: Can an outdoor gym fit along a narrow riverside strip?
items.a: Yes. Place the machines in a single row with enough clear space in front of each one. Send us the length and width and we will draw a layout that fits.

items.q: Will riverside humidity damage the equipment?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and many parts are roto-moulded, both suited to damp air. Regular wiping and the maintenance steps we share help them last.

items.q: Is the Fun Rower easy for older users?
items.a: It is a seated machine with a smooth pulling motion, so many older users find it comfortable. Anyone with health concerns should check with their doctor first.
